'''Varko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He spent several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] learning [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|galactic basic]], and eventually became a [[immigration officer]]. During his job [[Darth Arkous]] was accepted past immigration. Two days later, a Republic citizen named [[Theron Shan|Tev Fith]] landed on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] who claimed he did research in [[biotech]], but he had no permit that allowed him to bypass the [[Order of Shasa]]'s law of offworlders not being allowed to travel two hundred meters distance or fifty meters depth from the [[Mercantile Plaza]]. Just as his shift was about to end, [[Lana Beniko]], who was after Darth Arkous used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to bypass immigration.<ref name="Surface Details" />
